skill.name: forensics
skill.description: Extracts hidden data from files and analyzes forensic artifacts. Use when working with images, memory dumps, disk images, steganography, file carving, or when searching for hidden flags in files.
skill.body:
# Forensics Analysis Skill

## Quick Workflow

```
Progress:
- [ ] Identify file type (file, xxd)
- [ ] Check metadata (exiftool)
- [ ] Search strings for flag
- [ ] Check for embedded data (binwalk)
- [ ] Try steganography tools
- [ ] Extract hidden content
```

## Step 1: Quick Analysis

```bash
file suspicious_file
exiftool suspicious_file
strings suspicious_file | grep -iE "flag|ctf|secret|key"
binwalk suspicious_file
```

## Step 2: Identify Challenge Type

| File Type | Approach | Reference |
|-----------|----------|-----------|
| Image (PNG/JPG) | Steganography | [reference/steganography.md](reference/steganography.md) |
| Memory dump | Volatility | [reference/memory.md](reference/memory.md) |
| Unknown/corrupted | File analysis | [reference/file-analysis.md](reference/file-analysis.md) |
| PCAP | Network skill | Use `networking` skill |

## Image Stego - Quick Start

```bash
# Try AperiSolve first (online)
# https://www.aperisolve.com/

# PNG
zsteg image.png
zsteg -a image.png

# JPEG
steghide extract -sf image.jpg
stegseek image.jpg rockyou.txt  # Brute force
```

**Full techniques**: [reference/steganography.md](reference/steganography.md)

## Memory Dump - Quick Start

```bash
# Volatility 3
vol -f memory.dmp windows.info
vol -f memory.dmp windows.pslist
vol -f memory.dmp windows.filescan | grep -i flag
```

**Full techniques**: [reference/memory.md](reference/memory.md)

## File Carving - Quick Start

```bash
binwalk -e suspicious_file      # Extract embedded files
foremost -i file -o output/     # Carve files

# Fix corrupted header
xxd file | head -10             # Check magic bytes
```

**Full techniques**: [reference/file-analysis.md](reference/file-analysis.md)

## Online Tools

| Tool | URL | Purpose |
|------|-----|---------|
| AperiSolve | aperisolve.com | All-in-one stego |
| StegOnline | stegonline.georgeom.net | Image analysis |
| CyberChef | gchq.github.io/CyberChef | Data transform |

## Reference Files

- **[Steganography](reference/steganography.md)**: Image/audio stego, LSB, AperiSolve
- **[Memory](reference/memory.md)**: Volatility 2/3, process analysis
- **[File Analysis](reference/file-analysis.md)**: Magic bytes, binwalk, password cracking

generated_query: I’ve been given a PNG image from a CTF challenge, and the hint says the flag is hidden using standard steganography techniques. I need to check the metadata, search for any embedded strings, and try common stego extraction methods like zsteg and steghide to recover the flag. Can you help me walk through the process and identify the hidden content?

## Embedded File Extraction – Quick Start

```bash
# Binwalk to find embedded files
binwalk -Me file.bin  # Automatically extract known signatures

# Foremost for file carving
foremost -t jpg,png,pdf -i file.bin -o carved_output/

# TestDisk for partition recovery (if disk image)
testdisk /dev/sdb
```

**Full techniques**: [reference/file-analysis.md](reference/file-analysis.md)

## Memory Dump – Quick Start

```bash
# Volatility 3 (for Linux/Windows dumps)
vol -f memory.dmp linux.bash
vol -f memory.dmp windows.cmdline
vol -f memory.dmp windows.malfind

# Identify suspicious processes
vol -f memory.dmp windows.pstree
```

**Full techniques**: [reference/memory.md](reference/memory.md)

## Hex Analysis & Header Repair

```bash
# Check first bytes (magic bytes)
xxd file | head -10

# Fix a corrupted header (PNG example)
printf '\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n' | dd of=file bs=1 seek=0 conv=notrunc

# Hachoir-metadata for detailed hex
hachoir-metadata file
```

**Full techniques**: [reference/file-analysis.md](reference/file-analysis.md)

| Tool | URL | Purpose |
|------|-----|---------|
| HexEd.it | hexed.it | Online hex editor |
| FotoForensics | fotoforensics.com | Error level analysis (ELA) |
| VirusTotal | virustotal.com | Check file hash against known malware |

- **[Memory](reference/memory.md)**: Volatility, process & network artifact extraction
- **[Disk](reference/disk.md)**: Mounting images, MBR/GPT recovery, slack space

## File Carving - Quick Start

```bash
binwalk -e suspicious_file      # Extract embedded files
foremost -i file -o output/     # Carve files

# Fix corrupted header
xxd file | head -10             # Check magic bytes
```
